note: Wikidata q-ids only. Centre is Wikidata's point for the city (Q1492). Ten of these sixteen places are carried over from the Explorer product on origin/main; the Explorer pin audit (docs/world/research/explorer-pins.json) gave two of them a wrong or doubtful item and both were re-chosen here: La Rambla (Q850593) is a 1.2 km street whose point sits 579 m from the Explorer pin, so the pin is now the Font de Canaletes (Q2723971), the fountain the Explorer text was actually about; and the Sagrada Família audit had matched the METRO STATION (Q2548808), so the basilica (Q48435) is used. The three museum q-ids proposed in the brief were checked and all three are wrong on Wikidata itself: Q1139034 is a plant, Q1478227 an Austrian economist and Q13161 a monument in Irkutsk. The real items were found by searching in Catalan: CosmoCaixa Q2625747, Drassanes Reials Q263924 (the building that holds the Museu Marítim, whose institution item is Q1286354, 30 m away — the building is the one that ships, per the rule), Museu Picasso Q1050032 (not used). No place claims an 'entrance': no door has been measured from a licensable source, so every point is the centroid or area it actually is, and the venue's own address goes into location.findIt in the city file instead.

places.name: Sagrada Família
places.note: The basilica, not the metro station (Q2548808) that the Explorer audit had matched. Visitor entrance is on Carrer de la Marina per sagradafamilia.org/en/schedules-how-to-get; the stored point is the building's centre.

places.name: Font de Canaletes (La Rambla)
places.note: Replaces La Rambla (Q850593), which graded 'wrong' in the Explorer pin audit: a street over a kilometre long has no useful point. The fountain at its top is where the Explorer text sent the child anyway.

places.name: Park Güell
places.note: A park on a hillside: an area pin. The Explorer audit's 68 m delta is the park's size, not a wrong item.

places.name: CosmoCaixa
places.note: The museum item carries the coordinate; the 1909 building item (Q94638192, Empar de Santa Llúcia) sits 4 m away and only covers the old asylum, while the museum is mostly the 2004 extension underneath it. Same pin either way.

places.name: Museu Marítim (Drassanes Reials)
places.note: The building (the medieval Royal Shipyard), not the institution (Q1286354) — the two points are 30 m apart and the shipyard is what a child stands in.

places.name: Parc d'Atraccions Tibidabo
places.note: The amusement park, not the mountain (Q1067823) and not the church on the summit (Q1189293), which is 100 m away and would be a second pin for the same hilltop.
